description: Agent routing config for differentiated improvement loop (Directions B-D)

agent_routing.description: Direction B: Differentiated agents for review vs fix

architecture_pass.description: Highest-quality model for architecture-level review. Read-only — never modifies code.

consistency_pass.description: Grep-based cross-file pattern matching. Cheap, parallel, grep-focused.

interface_pass.description: Caller-callee signature verification, config field usage audit.
interface_pass.trigger: Every iteration, Pass C, or on-demand after signature changes

coverage_pass.description: Maps modified modules to test files, checks for gaps.
coverage_pass.trigger: Every iteration, Pass D. Required before fix phase.

primary.description: Goal-oriented autonomous execution for fix batches.

regression_scan.description: Quick check for fix side effects. Must run after every fix batch.
regression_scan.trigger: After fix phase, before next review

review_passes.description: Direction C: Specialized review passes replacing single generic review

passes.name: Architecture Pass
passes.description: High-level design, module boundaries, cross-module concerns, extensibility

passes.name: Consistency Pass
passes.description: Cross-file pattern divergence check: sibling modules, repeated patterns, naming conventions

passes.name: Interface Contract Pass
passes.description: Caller-callee signature alignment, config field consumption audit, return type verification

passes.name: Test Coverage Pass
passes.description: Modified modules → test file mapping, gap detection, contract drift check

review_passes.result_aggregation: All pass results collected before entering fix phase. Critical/major across any pass → fix. Only minor in single pass → note but don't block.

regression_scan.description: Direction D: Post-fix regression detection before next review cycle

checks.name: Test Contract Drift
checks.description: Check if modified function signatures broke existing tests. Run full test suite.

checks.name: Sibling Pattern Sync
checks.description: For each modified file, check if sibling files have the same pattern that needs updating.
checks.method: explore agent: 'File X was modified to fix pattern Y. Check if files A, B, C have the same pattern.'

checks.name: Side Effect Check
checks.description: Verify no broken imports, no dead code left behind, no new unused imports.
checks.method: python -c 'import <modified_modules>' check + grep for unused imports

session_continuity.description: Cross-session knowledge persistence to compensate for context clearing
session_continuity.load_action: Must be loaded as review prompt preamble at start of every new session
session_continuity.purpose: New session agent can see: 'In 6 prior iterations, cross-file inconsistency was the most common bug class. Pay special attention to sibling files.'
